audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Kings / Melakhim Aleph chapter 7, first-pass draft aligned to public-domain verse structure; formal architectural and witness audit remains required.
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for palace-temple comparison, Pharaoh's daughter, costly stone, Hiram the artisan, widow identity, bronze craft, pillars, sea and oxen, mobile lavers, creation imagery, mass metal extraction, and attribution of labor.

verses.restored: Solomon built his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

familiar.text: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

modern.text: Solomon, however, took thirteen years to complete the construction of his entire palace.

original.text: וְאֶת בֵּיתוֹ֙ בָּנָ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיְכַ֖ל אֶת כָּל בֵּיתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He built House of Forest of Lebanon: one hundred cubits long, fifty wide, and thirty high, upon four rows of cedar pillars with cedar beams upon pillars.

familiar.text: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

modern.text: He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high, with four rows of cedar pillars supporting the cedar beams.

original.text: וַיִּ֜בֶן אֶת בֵּ֣ית יַ֣עַר הַלְּבָנ֗וֹן מֵאָ֨ה אַמָּ֤ה אָרְכּוֹ֙ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָת֑וֹ עַ֗ל אַרְבָּעָה֙ טוּרֵי֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וּכְרֻת֥וֹת אֲרָזִ֖ים עַל הָעַמּוּדִֽים

verses.restored: It was roofed with cedar above chambers upon forty-five pillars, fifteen in a row.

familiar.text: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.

modern.text: The house was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the pillars—forty-five beams, fifteen per row.

original.text: וְסָפֻ֣ן בָּאֶ֗רֶז מִמַּ֨עַל֙ עַל הַצְּלָעֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַטּֽוּר

verses.restored: There were window frames in three rows, light opposite light in three ranks.

familiar.text: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.

modern.text: There were three rows of high windows facing one another in three tiers.

original.text: וּשְׁקֻפִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה טוּרִ֑ים וּמֶחֱזָ֥ה אֶל מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים

verses.restored: All entrances and doorposts were square with frames, and light was opposite light in three ranks.

familiar.text: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.

modern.text: All the doorways had rectangular frames, with the openings facing one another in three tiers.

original.text: וְכָל הַפְּתָחִ֥ים וְהַמְּזוּז֖וֹת רְבֻעִ֣ים שָׁ֑קֶף וּמ֧וּל מֶחֱזָ֛ה אֶל מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים

verses.restored: He made Porch of Pillars, fifty cubits long and thirty wide, with a porch before them and pillars and threshold before them.

familiar.text: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.

modern.text: Solomon made his colonnade fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide, with a portico in front of it and a canopy with pillars in front of the portico.

original.text: וְאֵ֨ת אוּלָ֤ם הָֽעַמּוּדִים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑וֹ וְאוּלָם֙ עַל פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַמֻּדִ֥ים וְעָ֖ב עַל פְּנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: He made Porch of Throne where he judged, Porch of Judgment, covered with cedar from floor to floor.

familiar.text: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

modern.text: In addition, he built a hall for the throne, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge. It was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.

original.text: וְאוּלָ֤ם הַכִּסֵּא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁפָּט שָׁ֔ם אֻלָ֥ם הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט עָשָׂ֑ה וְסָפ֣וּן בָּאֶ֔רֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַ֖ע עַד הַקַּרְקָֽע

verses.restored: His house where he lived had another court within porch, of similar work. Solomon also made a house like this porch for Pharaoh's daughter whom he had taken.

familiar.text: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.

modern.text: And the palace where Solomon would live, set further back, was of similar construction. He also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.

original.text: וּבֵיתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁר יֵ֨שֶׁב שָׁ֜ם חָצֵ֣ר הָאַחֶ֗רֶת מִבֵּית֙ לָֽאוּלָ֔ם כַּמַּֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וּבַ֜יִת יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְבַת פַּרְעֹה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כָּאוּלָ֖ם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: All these were costly stones, cut to measure, sawed with saws inside and outside, from foundation to coping and outside toward great court.

familiar.text: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.

modern.text: All these buildings were constructed with costly stones, cut to size and trimmed with saws inside and out from the foundation to the eaves, and from the outside to the great courtyard.

original.text: כָּל אֵ֜לֶּה אֲבָנִ֤ים יְקָרֹת֙ כְּמִדֹּ֣ת גָּזִ֔ית מְגֹרָר֥וֹת בַּמְּגֵרָ֖ה מִבַּ֣יִת וּמִח֑וּץ וּמִמַּסָּד֙ עַד הַטְּפָח֔וֹת וּמִח֖וּץ עַד הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַגְּדוֹלָֽה

verses.restored: Foundation was costly, great stones—stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

familiar.text: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

modern.text: The foundations were laid with large, costly stones, some ten cubits long and some eight cubits long.

original.text: וּמְיֻסָּ֕ד אֲבָנִ֥ים יְקָר֖וֹת אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת אַבְנֵי֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת וְאַבְנֵ֖י שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת

verses.restored: Above were costly stones cut to measure and cedar.

familiar.text: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

modern.text: Above these were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.

original.text: וּמִלְמַ֗עְלָה אֲבָנִ֧ים יְקָר֛וֹת כְּמִדּ֥וֹת גָּזִ֖ית וָאָֽרֶז

verses.restored: Great court around had three rows of hewn stone and one row of cedar beams, as inner court of house of YHWH and porch of house.

familiar.text: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.

modern.text: The great courtyard was surrounded by three rows of dressed stone and a row of trimmed cedar beams, as were the inner courtyard and portico of the house of the LORD. The Pillars and Capitals (2 Chronicles 3:14–17)

original.text: וְחָצֵ֨ר הַגְּדוֹלָ֜ה סָבִ֗יב שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ טוּרִ֣ים גָּזִ֔ית וְט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֣ת אֲרָזִ֑ים וְלַחֲצַ֧ר בֵּית יְהוָ֛ה הַפְּנִימִ֖ית וּלְאֻלָ֥ם הַבָּֽיִת

verses.restored: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram from Tyre.

familiar.text: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

modern.text: Now King Solomon sent to bring Huram from Tyre.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֶת חִירָ֖ם מִצֹּֽר

verses.restored: He was son of a widow from tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a Tyrian man, a bronze worker. He was filled with wisdom, understanding, and knowledge to do all work in bronze. He came to King Solomon and did all his work.

familiar.text: He was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

modern.text: He was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a craftsman in bronze. Huram had great skill, understanding, and knowledge for every kind of bronze work. So he came to King Solomon and carried out all his work.

original.text: בֶּן אִשָּׁה֩ אַלְמָנָ֨ה ה֜וּא מִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וְאָבִ֣יו אִישׁ צֹרִי֮ חֹרֵ֣שׁ נְחֹשֶׁת֒ וַ֠יִּמָּלֵא אֶת הַחָכְמָ֤ה וְאֶת הַתְּבוּנָה֙ וְאֶת הַדַּ֔עַת לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּל מְלָאכָ֖ה בַּנְּחֹ֑שֶׁת וַיָּבוֹא֙ אֶל הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת כָּל מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: He cast two bronze pillars, each eighteen cubits high; a cord of twelve cubits surrounded each.

familiar.text: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.

modern.text: He cast two pillars of bronze, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.

original.text: וַיָּ֛צַר אֶת שְׁנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה אַמָּ֗ה קוֹמַת֙ הָעַמּ֣וּד הָאֶחָ֔ד וְחוּט֙ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֖ב אֶת הָעַמּ֥וּד הַשֵּׁנִֽי

verses.restored: He made two capitals of cast bronze to set upon tops of pillars; height of each capital was five cubits.

familiar.text: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:

modern.text: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on top of the pillars, each capital five cubits high.

original.text: וּשְׁתֵּ֨י כֹתָרֹ֜ת עָשָׂ֗ה לָתֵ֛ת עַל רָאשֵׁ֥י הָֽעַמּוּדִ֖ים מֻצַ֣ק נְחֹ֑שֶׁת חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת קוֹמַת֙ הַכֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ת וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת קוֹמַ֖ת הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית

verses.restored: Networks of latticework and wreaths of chainwork were for capitals atop pillars, seven for one and seven for other.

familiar.text: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

modern.text: For the capitals on top of the pillars he made a network of lattice, with wreaths of chainwork, seven for each capital.

original.text: שְׂבָכִ֞ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂבָכָ֗ה גְּדִלִים֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שַׁרְשְׁר֔וֹת לַכֹּ֣תָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֑ים שִׁבְעָה֙ לַכֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ת וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה לַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית

verses.restored: He made pillars with two rows of pomegranates around one network to cover capitals; thus for other capital.

familiar.text: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

modern.text: Likewise, he made the pillars with two rows of pomegranates around each grating to cover each capital atop the pillars.

original.text: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת הָעַמּוּדִ֑ים וּשְׁנֵי֩ טוּרִ֨ים סָבִ֜יב עַל הַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֗ת לְכַסּ֤וֹת אֶת הַכֹּֽתָרֹת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָֽרִמֹּנִ֔ים וְכֵ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לַכֹּתֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית

verses.restored: Capitals atop pillars were of lily work in porch, four cubits.

familiar.text: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

modern.text: And the capitals atop the pillars in the portico were shaped like lilies, four cubits high.

original.text: וְכֹֽתָרֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה שׁוּשַׁ֣ן בָּֽאוּלָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֖ע אַמּֽוֹת

verses.restored: Capitals upon two pillars had pomegranates above near belly beside network, two hundred in rows around each capital.

familiar.text: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

modern.text: On the capitals of both pillars, just above the rounded projection next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows encircling each capital.

original.text: וְכֹתָרֹ֗ת עַל שְׁנֵי֙ הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים גַּם מִמַּ֨עַל֙ מִלְּעֻמַּ֣ת הַבֶּ֔טֶן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֵ֣בֶר שבכה וְהָרִמּוֹנִ֤ים מָאתַ֨יִם֙ טֻרִ֣ים סָבִ֔יב עַ֖ל הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית

verses.restored: He raised pillars at porch of temple. He raised right pillar and named it Jachin; he raised left pillar and named it Boaz.

familiar.text: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

modern.text: Thus he set up the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jachin, and the pillar to the north he named Boaz.

original.text: וַיָּ֨קֶם֙ אֶת הָֽעַמֻּדִ֔ים לְאֻלָ֖ם הַֽהֵיכָ֑ל וַיָּ֜קֶם אֶת הָעַמּ֣וּד הַיְמָנִ֗י וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת שְׁמוֹ֙ יָכִ֔ין וַיָּ֨קֶם֙ אֶת הָעַמּ֣וּד הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔י וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖וֹ בֹּֽעַז

verses.restored: Upon tops of pillars was lily work. Work of pillars was finished.

familiar.text: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

modern.text: And the tops of the pillars were shaped like lilies. So the work of the pillars was completed. The Molten Sea (2 Chronicles 4:1–5)

original.text: וְעַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן וַתִּתֹּ֖ם מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָעַמּוּדִֽים

verses.restored: He made a cast sea, ten cubits from brim to brim, round all around, five cubits high, and a line of thirty cubits surrounded it.

familiar.text: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

modern.text: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּ֠אַמָּה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ עַד שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָגֹ֣ל סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קוֹמָת֔וֹ וקוה שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: Under its brim around were gourds, ten to a cubit, surrounding sea in two rows cast with it.

familiar.text: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

modern.text: Below the rim, ornamental buds encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.

original.text: וּפְקָעִים֩ מִתַּ֨חַת לִשְׂפָת֤וֹ סָבִיב֙ סֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּפִ֥ים אֶת הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנֵ֤י טוּרִים֙ הַפְּקָעִ֔ים יְצֻקִ֖ים בִּיצֻקָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: It stood upon twelve oxen: three facing north, three west, three south, and three east. Sea was above them, and all their backs turned inward.

familiar.text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

modern.text: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The Sea rested on them, with all their hindquarters toward the center.

original.text: עֹמֵ֞ד עַל שְׁנֵ֧י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכָל אֲחֹֽרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה

verses.restored: It was a handbreadth thick; its brim was made like brim of cup, like lily blossom. It held two thousand baths.

familiar.text: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

modern.text: It was a handbreadth thick, and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold two thousand baths. The Ten Bronze Stands

original.text: וְעָבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָת֛וֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה שְׂפַת כּ֖וֹס פֶּ֣רַח שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בַּ֖ת יָכִֽיל

verses.restored: He made ten bronze stands, each four cubits long, four wide, and three high.

familiar.text: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

modern.text: In addition, he made ten movable stands of bronze, each four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.

original.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת הַמְּכֹנ֛וֹת עֶ֖שֶׂר נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וְאַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽאַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ בָּאַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽהּ

verses.restored: Work of stands was this: they had panels, and panels were between frames.

familiar.text: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:

modern.text: This was the design of the stands: They had side panels attached to uprights,

original.text: וְזֶ֛ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַמְּכוֹנָ֖ה מִסְגְּרֹ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וּמִסְגְּרֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין הַשְׁלַבִּֽים

verses.restored: Upon panels between frames were lions, oxen, and cherubim; above frames was a pedestal, and beneath lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

familiar.text: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.

modern.text: and on the panels between the uprights were lions, oxen, and cherubim. On the uprights was a pedestal above, and below the lions and oxen were wreaths of beveled work.

original.text: וְעַֽל הַמִּסְגְּר֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּ֣ין הַשְׁלַבִּ֗ים אֲרָי֤וֹת בָּקָר֙ וּכְרוּבִ֔ים וְעַל הַשְׁלַבִּ֖ים כֵּ֣ן מִמָּ֑עַל וּמִתַּ֨חַת֙ לַאֲרָי֣וֹת וְלַבָּקָ֔ר לֹי֖וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה מוֹרָֽד

verses.restored: Each stand had four bronze wheels and bronze axles. Its four feet had supports; beneath basin supports were cast beside each wreath.

familiar.text: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

modern.text: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles and a basin resting on four supports, with wreaths at each side.

original.text: וְאַרְבָּעָה֩ אוֹפַנֵּ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת לַמְּכוֹנָ֤ה הָֽאַחַת֙ וְסַרְנֵ֣י נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה פַעֲמֹתָ֖יו כְּתֵפֹ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם מִתַּ֤חַת לַכִּיֹּר֙ הַכְּתֵפֹ֣ת יְצֻק֔וֹת מֵעֵ֥בֶר אִ֖ישׁ לֹיֽוֹת

verses.restored: Its opening within crown and above was one cubit; opening was round like pedestal, one and a half cubits, and upon opening were carvings. Panels were square, not round.

familiar.text: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

modern.text: The opening to each stand inside the crown at the top was one cubit deep, with a round opening like the design of a pedestal, a cubit and a half wide. And around its opening were engravings, but the panels of the stands were square, not round.

original.text: וּ֠פִיהוּ מִבֵּ֨ית לַכֹּתֶ֤רֶת וָמַ֨עְלָה֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וּפִ֨יהָ֙ עָגֹ֣ל מַעֲשֵׂה כֵ֔ן אַמָּ֖ה וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֑ה וְגַם עַל פִּ֨יהָ֙ מִקְלָע֔וֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶ֥ם מְרֻבָּע֖וֹת לֹ֥א עֲגֻלּֽוֹת

verses.restored: Four wheels were beneath panels, and wheel axles were in stand; height of each wheel was one and a half cubits.

familiar.text: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

modern.text: There were four wheels under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand; each wheel was a cubit and a half in diameter.

original.text: וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת הָאֽוֹפַנִּ֗ים לְמִתַּ֨חַת֙ לַֽמִּסְגְּר֔וֹת וִיד֥וֹת הָאֽוֹפַנִּ֖ים בַּמְּכוֹנָ֑ה וְקוֹמַת֙ הָאוֹפַ֣ן הָאֶחָ֔ד אַמָּ֖ה וַחֲצִ֥י הָאַמָּֽה

verses.restored: Work of wheels was like chariot wheels; their axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were all cast.

familiar.text: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.

modern.text: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; their axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were all of cast metal.

original.text: וּמַֽעֲשֵׂה֙ הָא֣וֹפַנִּ֔ים כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אוֹפַ֣ן הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֑ה יְדוֹתָ֣ם וְגַבֵּיהֶ֗ם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶ֛ם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶ֖ם הַכֹּ֥ל מוּצָֽק

verses.restored: Four supports were at four corners of each stand; supports were of stand itself.

familiar.text: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.

modern.text: Each stand had four handles, one for each corner, projecting from the stand.

original.text: וְאַרְבַּ֣ע כְּתֵפ֔וֹת אֶ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנּ֔וֹת הַמְּכֹנָ֖ה הָֽאֶחָ֑ת מִן הַמְּכֹנָ֖ה כְּתֵפֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: On top of stand was round band half a cubit high; on top, supports and panels were of one piece with it.

familiar.text: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.

modern.text: At the top of each stand was a circular band half a cubit high. The supports and panels were cast as a unit with the top of the stand.

original.text: וּבְרֹ֣אשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָ֗ה חֲצִ֧י הָאַמָּ֛ה קוֹמָ֖ה עָגֹ֣ל סָבִ֑יב וְעַ֨ל רֹ֤אשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה֙ יְדֹתֶ֔יהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּֽנָּה

verses.restored: Upon plates of supports and panels he engraved cherubim, lions, and palms, according to space of each, with wreaths around.

familiar.text: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

modern.text: He engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and panels, wherever each had space, with wreaths all around.

original.text: וַיְפַתַּ֤ח עַל הַלֻּחֹת֙ יְדֹתֶ֔יהָ וְעַל֙ ומסגרתיה כְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲרָי֣וֹת וְתִמֹרֹ֑ת כְּמַֽעַר אִ֥ישׁ וְלֹי֖וֹת סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: Thus he made ten stands; all had one casting, one measure, and one form.

familiar.text: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.

modern.text: In this way he made the ten stands, each with the same casting, dimensions, and shape. The Ten Bronze Basins (2 Chronicles 4:6–8)

original.text: כָּזֹ֣את עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת עֶ֣שֶׂר הַמְּכֹנ֑וֹת מוּצָ֨ק אֶחָ֜ד מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת קֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לְכֻלָּֽהְנָה

verses.restored: He made ten bronze basins; each held forty baths and was four cubits; one basin upon each of ten stands.

familiar.text: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.

modern.text: He also made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin for each of the ten stands.

original.text: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה כִיֹּר֖וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבָּעִ֨ים בַּ֜ת יָכִ֣יל הַכִּיּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֗ד אַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽאַמָּה֙ הַכִּיּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֔ד כִּיּ֤וֹר אֶחָד֙ עַל הַמְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָאַחַ֔ת לְעֶ֖שֶׂר הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת

verses.restored: He placed five stands on right side of house and five on left; sea he placed on right side of house, eastward toward south.

familiar.text: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.

modern.text: He set five stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north, and he put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple. Completion of the Bronze Works (2 Chronicles 4:11–18)

original.text: וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת הַמְּכֹנ֔וֹת חָמֵ֞שׁ עַל כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֨יִת֙ מִיָּמִ֔ין וְחָמֵ֛שׁ עַל כֶּ֥תֶף הַבַּ֖יִת מִשְּׂמֹאל֑וֹ וְאֶת הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֧יִת הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגֶב

verses.restored: Hiram made basins, shovels, and bowls. Hiram finished doing all work he made for King Solomon for house of YHWH:

familiar.text: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:

modern.text: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of the LORD:

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חִיר֔וֹם אֶת הַ֨כִּיֹּר֔וֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹת וַיְכַ֣ל חִירָ֗ם לַֽעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: two pillars, bowls of capitals atop pillars, and two networks covering bowls of capitals;

familiar.text: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;

modern.text: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars; the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars;

original.text: עַמֻּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְגֻלֹּ֧ת הַכֹּתָרֹ֛ת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָֽעַמֻּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְהַשְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלֹּ֣ת הַכֹּֽתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִֽים

verses.restored: four hundred pomegranates for two networks, two rows for each network covering bowls of capitals;

familiar.text: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;

modern.text: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars);

original.text: וְאֶת הָרִמֹּנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַשְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנֵֽי טוּרִ֤ים רִמֹּנִים֙ לַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָֽאֶחָ֔ת לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלֹּ֣ת הַכֹּֽתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִֽים

verses.restored: ten stands and ten basins upon stands;

familiar.text: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

modern.text: the ten stands; the ten basins on the stands;

original.text: וְאֶת הַמְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָ֑שֶׂר וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּרֹ֥ת עֲשָׂרָ֖ה עַל הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת

verses.restored: one sea and twelve oxen beneath sea;

familiar.text: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

modern.text: the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea;

original.text: וְאֶת הַיָּ֖ם הָאֶחָ֑ד וְאֶת הַבָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר תַּ֥חַת הַיָּֽם

verses.restored: pots, shovels, and bowls. All these vessels Hiram made for King Solomon for house of YHWH were polished bronze.

familiar.text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.

modern.text: and the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. All the articles that Huram made for King Solomon in the house of the LORD were made of burnished bronze.

original.text: וְאֶת הַסִּיר֨וֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִ֜ים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָק֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ כָּל הַכֵּלִ֣ים האהל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה חִירָ֛ם לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מְמֹרָֽט

verses.restored: In plain of Jordan king cast them in clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

familiar.text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

modern.text: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.

original.text: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵ֖ה הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צָרְתָֽן

verses.restored: Solomon left all vessels unweighed because they were exceedingly many; weight of bronze was not investigated.

familiar.text: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

modern.text: Solomon left all these articles unweighed, because there were so many. The weight of the bronze could not be determined. Completion of the Gold Furnishings (2 Chronicles 4:19–22)

original.text: וַיַּנַּ֤ח שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת כָּל הַכֵּלִ֔ים מֵרֹ֖ב מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת

verses.restored: Solomon made all vessels belonging to house of YHWH: gold altar and gold table upon which was bread of Presence;

familiar.text: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,

modern.text: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of the LORD: the golden altar; the golden table on which was placed the Bread of the Presence;

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל הַכֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֚ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלָ֛יו לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִ֖ים זָהָֽב

verses.restored: lampstands of pure gold, five on right and five on left before inner sanctuary, with flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold;

familiar.text: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,

modern.text: the lampstands of pure gold in front of the inner sanctuary, five on the right side and five on the left; the gold flowers, lamps, and tongs;

original.text: וְאֶת הַ֠מְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵ֨שׁ מִיָּמִ֜ין וְחָמֵ֧שׁ מִשְּׂמֹ֛אול לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וְהַפֶּ֧רַח וְהַנֵּרֹ֛ת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָֽב

verses.restored: cups, snuffers, bowls, spoons, firepans of pure gold, and gold hinges for doors of inner house, most holy place, and doors of temple house.

familiar.text: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.

modern.text: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers; and the gold hinges for the doors of the inner temple (that is, the Most Holy Place ) as well as for the doors of the main hall of the temple.

verses.restored: All work King Solomon made for house of YHWH was finished. Solomon brought things David his father had dedicated—silver, gold, and vessels—and placed them among treasures of house of YHWH.

familiar.text: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.

modern.text: So all the work that King Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed. Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.

translation_notes: Solomon spends thirteen years on his palace complex after seven years on the temple. The juxtaposition invites scrutiny of royal self-investment beside sacred devotion.
Pharaoh's daughter receives a palace but remains unnamed and represented through Solomon's marriage acquisition.
Hiram the artisan—not Hiram the king—is a widow's son with Israelite and Tyrian family ties. His craft wisdom is central and should not disappear under Solomon's authorship.
The bronze work celebrates technical knowledge, casting, measurement, engineering, and art. Skilled manual labor is wisdom.
Pillars, pomegranates, lilies, palms, lions, oxen, cherubim, and the sea create a symbolic cosmos of stability, fertility, royal force, and sacred presence.
The twelve bronze oxen are crafted supports, but animal imagery should not erase the living animals consumed throughout the cultic system.
The unweighed abundance of bronze and extensive gold point to enormous extraction, transport, furnace labor, fuel use, and wealth concentration.
David and Solomon receive narrative credit, while Hiram and countless miners, charcoal makers, mold builders, carriers, polishers, and assistants remain mostly unnamed.
safety_note: Do not use sacred or royal beauty to erase labor, ecology, wealth concentration, gendered dynastic arrangements, or foreign expertise. Artisanship is wisdom, and workers are not extensions of a king's glory.
